about: The folded form used for search, for category filtering and for the parental check.
notes: Accents are stripped, case is dropped, and every run of anything else becomes a single space, trimmed at both ends.

This is the function a channel is hidden by AND the function it is searched by. The two drifting apart is a real bug this project shipped: a channel folded one way for the list and lowercased another way for the check played from a favourite while being invisible everywhere else.

cases.name: collapses punctuation to a single space
a name of only punctuation folds to nothing
an empty name folds to nothing
German sharp s is not an ASCII letter and becomes a space
cases.why: Recorded because it is a real limitation, not an accident: NFD leaves ß alone, so `Straße` and `Strasse` do not fold alike. Any second implementation must match this, right or wrong, or the two disagree about what is hidden.
